title: Ordering
description: Put the items in the correct order.
instructions: Every question in this quiz is of one type: Ordering.
Use it to test how this question type looks and is marked.

questions.question: Put these steps for making a soluble salt from an insoluble base in order.
items: Add the insoluble base until some stays undissolved
Heat the filtrate to evaporate some water
Leave to crystallise, then dry the crystals
questions.explanation: The base is added in excess so all the acid reacts.

questions.question: Put the planets in order from the Sun.
Put the fetch–decode–execute cycle in order. (Exact order only.)
questions.explanation: The CPU repeats this cycle for every instruction.

questions.question: Put the steps for solving 3x + 5 = 20 in order.
questions.explanation: Undo the addition first, then the multiplication.
